description: Location corrections found during gym-information research batch 5 (non-metro gyms, part 2, mostly Germany): 50 gyms whose pin was far from the official address (several in another town, up to ~100 km) or whose address was missing. Address from the official site; pin from the OpenStreetMap element for the gym; checked 2026-10-04. Names, suburbs and type tags are not changed here.
